# Validate Workflow Assembly
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Decide whether the configured workflow is ready to execute. This operation does not run production.

## Interface

```text
Configured contracts + validation checklist -> inspect assembly -> pass or routed findings
```

| Input | Scope | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `../validation-checklist.md` | Full file | Acceptance checks |
| `../scripts/validate.py` | Full file | Deterministic structural checks |
| Configured `AGENTS.md`, `CONTEXT.md`, `_config/`, `setup/initialization-record.md` | Active contracts | Identity, routing, source ownership, gates |
| Configured stage `CONTEXT.md` and declared stable references | Only active stages and references they name | Interfaces and handoffs |

**Input gate:** Confirm the destination and that the active stage list is known. If an expected file is missing, record a finding rather than assume its contents.

**One transformation:** Run `python3 <source>/scripts/validate.py --workflow <destination>` for deterministic checks first, then apply semantic checklist items to the assembled workflow. Trace one request through production, Measure, correction, and Learn using declared paths. Inspect runtime schemas without creating a run. Map each failure to Define, Build Stage, Build Router, Build Agent, or Add Quality.

| Output | Location | Format | Consumer |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pass decision or failed checks with file, evidence, and repair operation | Chat or `<destination>/setup/validation-result.md` if saving was requested | Markdown | Builder and user |
| Validated setup decisions | `<destination>/setup/initialization-record.md` | Markdown | Future maintenance |

**Verify:** No populated Layer 4 files live in the reusable workflow; paths and consumers match; required setup placeholders are resolved. A failed structural or semantic check prevents execution. After repair, rerun only affected checks and interface paths, then record the result.
